sachin: Heads up — saw a steady tail-latency increase on Qwen long-context runs starting ~3842100000. Memory graph shows KV residency jump when rope scale crosses 32k. I dumped KV pages and a heap sample.

marta: Can you paste the dump? I'm guessing fragmentation + small-page churn from MQA path.

sachin: pasted minimal excerpt:
```
$ ./kv_inspect --pool 3 --range 0..65536 > /tmp/kv-3842.txt
pool=3 total_pages=1248 active=1193 fragmented=412 avg_residency=0.76
slot-size=2048 rope-scale=32768 model-tag=QWEN-220B-gqa-mqa
evict_ops=8423 reclaim_fail=221 last_eviction=3842099001
```

lee: hmm reclaim_fail is concerning. Could be kernel selection flipping to the generic batch kernel when sequence lengths vary — that increases page churn.

perf-bot: perf regression detected: tail_p99_latency_up 18% over baseline for qwen_gqa_mqa@rope=32768 on cohort 'longprefix-warm'. See /perf/3842103456

anna: Did we try pinning the kernel for the gqa path? There was a patch that changes kernel heuristics for MQA last month.

sachin: I ran a quick AB: forcing kernel=v2_lowmem reduces reclaim_fail to 3 but increases median latency 6%. So it's trading off reclaim stability vs median throughput.

marta: Suggestion: add a targeted KV compaction on canary before switching kernel. We can trigger after N failed reclaims to avoid bursts.

lee: Also check prefix reuse: patterns show repeated prefixes that don't get optimal prefix-KV caching because rope scaling changes slot aliasing. If slot aliasing increases fragmentation, compaction helps.

sachin: I'll run a longer trace with full KV page-level timestamps and correlate with batching histograms. Sharing a link when ready.

anna: thx. if you need a follow-up canary run, I can spin up a dedicated instance with quantized kernels to test.

marta: also cc @eng-sre to watch memory alarms, just in case :eyes:

perf-bot: alert suppressed for 10m pending investigation (auto-ack by sachin)
